name: const unsafe fn from_ptr < 'a > (ptr : * mut bool) -> & 'a AtomicBool
rule: Every pair of non-synchronized atomic accesses involving the memory at `ptr` must either access disjoint regions, access exactly the same region with the same access size, or both be reads. Accesses are non-synchronized when neither happens-before the other.
api: impl  core::sync::atomic::AtomicBool { const unsafe fn from_ptr < 'a > (ptr : * mut bool) -> & 'a core::sync::atomic::AtomicBool }
